source.author: Dan Ulrich
source.license_evidence: Selected asset collection metadata and the bundle's Human Base Meshes README both state CC0. No Rain Rig objects were imported.

workflow_tools.execution: Headless Blender CLI and data-level mesh edits; no computer use and no live sculpt-brush operations.

reference.use: Working visual design, packed into the blend; not calibrated photographic reconstruction.
reference.game_influence: Beautiful adult xianxia female character; no extracted game meshes or game textures used.

adaptation.method: 11 independently reversible local shape-key deltas, compact protection masks, preserved source Multires grids and eye globes.
adaptation.eye_cavity_protection: Eye-aperture edits fade to zero behind the visible lid region; control-cage intersection pairs compared to the source.
adaptation.body: Original body controls retained only to preserve Multires data, protected from local edits and hidden after Multires.
adaptation.inspection_snapshots: Hidden cage and high-surface collections are static verification snapshots; edit Qinglan_Head_Multires and regenerate them.
